end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Correctly identified goalpost pillars as standing lines and a ladder as slanting.
Discussed that slanting lines can still be straight.
Called V/zigzag shapes curved and initially said tilted lines were not straight; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised sorting lines by direction and noticed that standing, sleeping and slanting lines can all be straight. They correctly identified goalpost pillars as standing and later described a ladder as slanting, but the mix-up about corners and tilted lines was not confirmed corrected by the end. At home, ask Om to find one example of each line type and trace each one while saying whether it is straight and which direction it has.
